The main takeaway from our work is that

the presence of an alpha, beta- unsaturated epoxide in a chemical structure can greatly enhance the hepatotoxicity, and perhaps other toxicities, of that compound, especially if the epoxide is not readily hydrolyzable.

the presence of an epoxide group in an aryl halide derivative greatly increases its hepatotoxicity, and that this is a general effect of the epoxide functional group, independent of its chemical environment.
